title: CoreApiAccountList
description: Response of GET /connectors/accounts: the accounts a connected connector reports, which the Profile page can assign to an entity. A connector whose health is open (disconnected) or that is not configured lists none.

items.title: CoreApiAccount
items.description: One assignable account. connector and accountRef are the values a ProfileAccountAssignment takes.

label.description: The connector's display name, such as Gmail.
